derivation: Restart reproduces the base authority refusal before the timer overflow and exact replay cannot rearm or erase the retained failure.

obligations.text: Document transmission requires ordinary declared authority and its independent amount limit. Stop pending automated transmission 999999999999 seconds after the first admitted available-clock authority failure of transmission-content with SOURCE_OBSERVATION_RELATIONS; repeated failures cannot reset the interval and only terminal completion discharges it.
